themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to perform research tasks autonomously, interact with systems, and make decisions within research contexts.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and review code, often acting as collaborative coding partners.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles discussing the creation and use of artificial users or personas for testing, research, or simulations.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses various AI-powered platforms, frameworks, and applications used to conduct research across different domains.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Articles detailing the use of AI to automate software testing, quality assurance processes, and test lab operations.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries and extract key insights.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Covers AI applications for gathering, analyzing, and understanding customer behavior, feedback, and preferences.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles specifically about the research, development, and implications of conversational AI chatbots, including their behavior and impact.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI influences job creation, displacement, skill requirements, and the overall nature of work.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Reviews, comparisons, and evaluations of different AI tools and platforms used for research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
